questions.question: What did the worthless shepherd in Zechariah 11 fail to do?
options: Gather in all of the wealth and the treasures of the many nations
Build a brand new temple upon the holy mountain of the LORD God
Lead the whole great army out to battle against the gathered great enemy
Care for the lost, the young, the maimed, or the healthy of the flock
questions.answer: Care for the lost, the young, the maimed, or the healthy of the flock

questions.question: How much was the shepherd's wages weighed out in Zechariah 11?
Zechariah broke two staffs named Favor and Union, signifying broken covenant and brotherhood.
They weighed out as my wages thirty pieces of _____.
Zechariah took two staffs, one named _____ and the other Union.
